narr: Thunderstorms continued to develop along the eastern periphery of the mid-level circulation associated with the remnants of Hurricane Kay. The mid-level feature allowed thunderstorm development from early morning through the day.
ev: The Seligman Fire Department reported 4 to 6 inches of water flowing over the streets in the center of town.
The Agua Fria River rose 4 feet near Cordes Junction. This is normally dry.
Flooding was reported along Highway 96 near Bagdad.
lsr: STREAM GAUGE ON AGUA FRIA RIVER INDICATED 4 FT RISE.
SELIGMAN FIRE DEPARTMENT ESTIMATED 4-6 INCHES OF WATER FLOWING OVER STREETS IN THE DOWNTOWN AREA.
